entries.name: initial-runtime-download
entries.outcome: Stopped the redundant builder Electron download after it stalled; local offline config now uses the locked node_modules/electron/dist. No dependency version changed.

entries.name: restricted-standard-token
entries.outcome: Installer file extraction returned 0 but no HKCU uninstall registration observed. Both Nova and stock Electron minimal windows failed with child 0xc0000135. Direct static-import DLL files exist; exact dynamic module/access failure remains unknown.

entries.name: owner-query
entries.outcome: CIM GetOwner in the restricted session was denied; null owner fields are not child-owner evidence. Administrator fresh installer child owner was observed separately.

entries.name: fixture-duration-assertion
entries.outcome: Initial harness required browser duration >2.0. Actual browser duration is exactly 2.0 while FFmpeg metadata is 2.020136; changed harness tolerance to 1.9..2.1, no media/application change.

entries.name: diagnostic-harness
entries.outcome: Passing an object to the no-argument preload method caused the preload to discard it and open a real SaveDialog, yielding a harness timeout. Removed that invalid test; no SaveDialog acceptance is claimed. Final actual installed collector is tested separately.

entries.name: asar-audit-locations
entries.outcome: Initial audit looked for notices inside ASAR instead of extraResources, then used slash paths for nested Windows ASAR members. Fixed audit only; final 23 checks pass.

entries.name: optional-window-probe
entries.outcome: Electron did not support Browser.getWindowForTarget in this context; subsequent external PS file invocation was blocked by existing execution policy. Kept both observations, removed the unused attempt, did not bypass/change policy. Manual window interaction stays pending.

entries.name: ledger-line-endings
entries.outcome: Initial dependency byte comparison failed on unchanged Git LF versus working CRLF. Corrected only line-ending normalization; all six dependency files and all 61 requirement identities remain unchanged.

entries.name: initial-focused-lint
entries.outcome: Removed an unused harness crypto import; final scoped lint passes.

entries.name: historical-nsis
entries.outcome: WER exception-data 0x23 identified as unexpected heap exception; no retained dump/call stack, root cause and public-release gate remain open.
